Definition: from G4862 and G3618; to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively):--build together.
BiblicalUsage: In Christ you also are built together for a habitation of God through the Spirit. The building together is the church itself, stone upon stone, until God has a house to live in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God builds His people together into a habitation for Himself, and I hold that I am one stone in that house, fitted beside the rest.
